summary: Nvni Group Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, prepared under IFRS. The filing includes balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, segment, warrant-fair-value, debenture and contingent-liability disaggregation data, with comparative periods and restated prior-period figures. No transaction, offer, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. As an ordinary periodic report by a foreign private issuer, it maps to a US domestic quarterly report on Form 10-Q; there is no deal-term or risk-arb angle to monitor.
